posture.content_addressing: F4: data/raw/{provider}/{date}/{sha256_12}.json.gz — identical bytes map to identical keys; overwrites are structurally meaningless (a changed byte is a NEW key)
posture.storage_class: E9: data/raw/ transitions GLACIER_IR@45d — cheap, instantly retrievable, delete-hostile
posture.attic: E9: data/attic/ IA@30d, NO expiry ever — Khalid's reversibility rule
posture.verification: provenance.raw_snapshot_key on wrapped values lets any published number be re-derived from archived provider bytes

honest_limits.s3_object_lock: TRUE WORM (Object Lock) requires versioning enabled at bucket creation — cannot be retrofitted to justhodl-dashboard-live. Stated, not hidden.
honest_limits.mitigation: deletion requires deliberate credentialed action against content-addressed keys nothing references by mutable name; F4 + E9 + IAM is the practical WORM for this bucket. If regulatory-grade lock is ever required: new locked bucket + replication (filed as future APR).
